title: A Bell for the Harvest
author: Freya Sandoval
blurb: Jonah Galloway, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
